## Activity

During February 2025, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 87 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and establishes the volume of work available for image quality review and grading. The activity was recorded against the site for the reporting period, with all captures considered in the subsequent review process.

## Image quality

Of the 87 captures, 7 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.0 per cent of captures. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The image quality result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for February 2025.

## Grading

Grading identified 15 referable results. The median grading lag was 2. This is the midpoint measure for the time between capture and grading during the reporting period. Together, the referable result count and the median grading lag summarise the grading outcome and timeliness for Oakridge Primary Care in February 2025.
